title: Sign in with an email link

intent.outcome: A cook signs in with a one-time link and lands on their pantry
intent.problem: Every recipe was public, so a cook could not keep a private list

acceptance_criteria.description: a cook who follows the link is signed in
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep -c '"email"' data/accounts.json && echo "the accounts have emails"

evidence.command: grep -c '"email"' data/accounts.json && echo "the accounts have emails"

steps.done_when: the link is in the outbox

rounds.notes: Two defects in the sign-in flow; D1 stops the release.

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The token is accepted twice

**where:** `pantry-web/src/signin.rs`

**defect:** the session is written before the token is consumed, so a replay signs the cook in again.

**scenario:** follow the link, press back, follow it again.

**fix:** consume the token before writing the session.
findings.resolution: the token is consumed before the session is written

comments.author: nadia
comments.body: re-checked the replay in a second browser: the token is consumed on the first follow

findings.description:
## D2 [low] The error page has no way back

**where:** `pantry-web/templates/error.html`

**defect:** a dead link leaves the cook on a blank page.

**scenario:** open an expired link.

**fix:** link back to the sign-in screen.
findings.resolution: a blank error page is the browser's, not the app's; it is out of scope

questions.question: Should the link live for fifteen minutes or an hour?

notes.author: mara
notes.body: the outbox worker already retries twice; reuse it
